# Standalone smoke-test project. Consumes an already-built/installed minifb shared
# library via find_package(), and must be configured/built AFTER minifb itself,
# never as part of the main project's build.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(minifb_shared_lib_smoke_test LANGUAGES C)

if (NOT DEFINED EXPECTED_VERSION_VARIANT OR EXPECTED_VERSION_VARIANT STREQUAL "")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "EXPECTED_VERSION_VARIANT must be set, e.g. -DEXPECTED_VERSION_VARIANT=linux-opengl")
endif()

find_package(minifb REQUIRED CONFIG)

configure_file(
    version_variant_test.c.in
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/version_variant_test.c"
    @ONLY
)

add_executable(version_variant_test "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/version_variant_test.c")
target_link_libraries(version_variant_test PRIVATE minifb::minifb)
set_target_properties(version_variant_test PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

install(TARGETS version_variant_test RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
